text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm out with Narita
Brian...

Huh, plushies... Reminds me a bit of the
old days.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I follow Нарита Брайан's gaze to a claw
machine
filled with Umamusume
plushies.

I had a plushie like that when I was little.
...My big
sis and I used to have matching
ones.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Not in plushies, and certainly not in claw

machines.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list:
Claw machines are more complex than they
seem.

text_block_list.text: ...How so? It's just a game, right?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: You need to have a keen sense of timing.

text_block_list.text:
...Oh? Then show me. Let's see what this
claw
machine thing is all about.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I'm taking the trouble to watch, so don't
waste my
time with anything but your
best.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Теперь я ни за что не могу подвести!
